question: Can the remaining CUDA, MPS, native Swift/Metal, and hardware-WebGPU evidence gaps be closed or measurably accelerated on their owning physical devices while preserving exact source counts, declared geometry, full-precision products, calibration, metadata, and cache-state provenance?

parameters.host_policy: Phil owns source and Apple profiling; Rodman is the physical 24 GB full-native gate; MJGOAT owns CUDA and source data; unrelated jobs are never displaced

MJGOAT RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 0 and GPU 1 only when unoccupied
